rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR ABDOMEN MRA / Other Vascular Abnormalities / Takayasu's Arteritis (15)
rules.source_quote: Takayasu's Arteritis (15): ○ At initial diagnosis ○ Every 6 months for the first 2 years while on therapy ○ Annually after the first 2 years

criteria.description: MRA requested at initial diagnosis, q6 months during first 2 years of active therapy, or annually thereafter

required_documentation: Rheumatology progress notes documenting Takayasu arteritis diagnosis, active immunosuppressive therapy, and prior imaging dates
rules.review_notes: Radiation-free surveillance intervals for large-vessel vasculitis.

rules.source_section: INDICATIONS FOR ABDOMEN MRA / Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm (AAA)
rules.source_quote: Known or suspected symptomatic AAA when (1,2) ○ Symptoms may include: ■ Abrupt onset of severe sharp or stabbing pain in the chest, back or abdomen (could indicate possible aneurysm rupture) ■ Acute abdominal or back pain with a pulsatile or epigastric mass

criteria.description: Known or clinically suspected symptomatic abdominal aortic aneurysm
Severe stabbing chest/back/abdominal pain or acute pain with pulsatile mass

required_documentation: Urgent clinical notes documenting acute abdominal/back pain and clinical rationale for MRA (e.g. severe iodinated contrast allergy precluding CTA)
rules.review_notes: Symptomatic AAA evaluation by MRA when CTA is contraindicated.
